## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      2 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 20 jul 2026 - 23 jul 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Lovelykoala🖤_, 23 jul 2026, 5/5: "It’s really easy to use, but has lots of useful features and you don’t need to pay for basic tools, which I appreciate very much. It is an amazing app even without premium, and also the developers always respond to ratings. Totally worth getting, helped me a lot!"
            2. _-paola__, 20 jul 2026, 5/5: "Started using this when I first started therapy and it’s just been there ever since. I’m an adult now and it’s crazy to think I have so many memories on here. I haven’t paid for a single thing and it’s still the best mood tracker I’ve had."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 24 jul 2026 - 24 jul 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _fctvtvyybybnu_, 24 jul 2026, 5/5: "My therapist had recommended this app to me and I was a little skeptical of it at first but it is an amazing app and I use it everyday! The only thing I don’t like about it is that there is a premium subscription that they bug you about often but that is the only downside to this app."
<!--/ir-theme-->
